item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
A US-brokered ceasefire now covers Oleshky and has been extended across the Kherson region, while local ceasefires operate in other frontline cities. Russian forces were blamed for a fire in the Russian city of Lipetsk after a reported Ukrainian strike, and Ukrainian forces recaptured territory, according to President Zelenskiy. President Putin held calls with the leaders of Finland and Norway, discussed Russian history, and faced split opinions among European leaders, while talks about lifting sanctions on a Russian investment fund continued. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Gaza’s women filmmakers have launched a new academy to turn pain into cinema. A Hebron groom was caught in a military lockdown. item.title: Iran and the regional confrontation: the situation
item.description:
Iran is urging the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz while Houthi missiles and drones continue striking Saudi oil facilities and airports, prompting the reopening of Riyadh Airport after weeks of disruption. The United States is weighing renewed strikes on Iran, pushing oil prices above $117 a barrel, and Iran’s supreme leader and top security chief discussed war and Hormuz. Nuclear inspectors reported no evidence that Iran repaired US-bombed nuclear sites, and the IAEA called for nuclear inspections. Israel’s election outcome is being watched for its impact on Iran policy. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Syria has condemned the strikes as a breach of its airspace and an unacceptable violation, and a joint Jordan-Syria security committee is being formed to investigate. Families of civilians killed in the attacks have held funerals, and Jordan says it killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in the operations. item.description:

Somalia denied a Turkish F‑16 airstrike on its army positions after clashes with al-Shabaab, and US forces were accused of weaponising floods that trapped women and children.
